title: Microwave Egg and Cheese English Muffin

steps.text: Coat -Coat a 6-oz. ramekin cup with cooking spray
visible_evidence: hand holding cooking spray can over ramekin cup
spray mist coating inside of ramekin
glistening interior surface of ramekin cup

checks.text: Cooking spray is directed into the interior of the ramekin cup

steps.text: Pour-Pour 1 egg into the ramekin cup
visible_evidence: cracking or pouring raw egg into ramekin cup
raw egg yolk and white inside ramekin cup

checks.text: The raw egg contents sit inside the ramekin cup

steps.text: Microwave-Microwave the ramekin cup uncovered on high for 30 seconds
visible_evidence: placing open ramekin cup into microwave
closing microwave door and pressing buttons
microwave running and timer counting down

checks.text: The ramekin cup is placed inside the microwave with its top open

steps.text: Cut -Cut the English muffin into two pieces with a knife
visible_evidence: hand slicing English muffin with a knife
English muffin separated into top and bottom halves

checks.text: A knife slices the English muffin horizontally into a top half and a bottom half

visible_evidence: hand holding fork or spoon inside ramekin cup
circular stirring motion mixing the egg

checks.text: A utensil mixes the partially cooked egg inside the ramekin cup

steps.text: Microwave -Continue to Microwave for 15-30 more seconds or until the egg is almost set
visible_evidence: returning ramekin cup to microwave
microwave running
egg in ramekin cup looking mostly solid

checks.text: The microwave runs for 15 to 30 seconds
The egg inside the ramekin cup appears mostly solidified

steps.text: Top -Top cup with 1 tablespoon of salsa
visible_evidence: spooning salsa into ramekin cup
red salsa layer resting on top of cooked egg

checks.text: Salsa rests on top of the cooked egg inside the ramekin cup

steps.text: sprinkle -sprinkle 1 tablespoon of cheese on cup
visible_evidence: hand or spoon sprinkling cheese over ramekin cup
shredded cheese resting on top of contents in cup

checks.text: Shredded cheese is scattered over the top of the contents in the ramekin cup

steps.text: Microwave -Microwave just until cheese melts, about 10 seconds
visible_evidence: placing topped ramekin cup in microwave
microwave running briefly
melted cheese visible on top of egg

checks.text: The microwave runs for approximately 10 seconds
The cheese on top of the egg is visibly melted

steps.text: Line -Line the bottom piece of the English muffin with lettuce
visible_evidence: hand placing lettuce leaf on bottom muffin half
lettuce resting on cut surface of bottom English muffin half

checks.text: Lettuce covers the cut surface of the bottom English muffin half

steps.text: Place -Place the egg from the cup over the lettuce
visible_evidence: scooping or tipping cooked egg out of ramekin cup
egg with salsa and melted cheese resting on top of lettuce

checks.text: The cooked egg with salsa and melted cheese rests on top of the lettuce on the bottom muffin half

steps.text: replace -replace the top of the English muffin
visible_evidence: hand placing top English muffin half onto the egg
assembled English muffin sandwich

checks.text: The top half of the English muffin sits over the egg to close the sandwich
